note: All curves are fitted 2-D screen-space models. No physical constant is derived; time base of 1930s footage may be altered (slow motion).

A_dive.method: hip position marked by eye on zoomed frames; camera translation by phase correlation on tree band y=15-45% ; world = screen - cam; x linear, y quadratic in t
A_dive.uncertainty: marking +/-8 px; pan estimate drift unknown; diver is an extended body, not a point

B_highdive.method: dark-blob tracking (local contrast > 40 vs 12px gaussian background, compact component), raw screen coordinates; same x-linear / y-quadratic model
B_highdive.why_it_departs: the camera tilts and pans to follow the diver; screen path records camera operation as much as flight. Cloud-based compensation was tried (phase correlation) and judged unreliable (low-contrast clouds, vignette).

C_doorway.method: outer rim of the arch marked by eye at one frame (t=1.0 s, static camera, checked stable at 0.5 and 2.5 s); parabola y(x) and algebraic circle fitted to the 11 crown samples; 4 jamb samples held out
C_doorway.uncertainty: arch only ~44 px wide in the 320x240 source; perspective slightly oblique; rim is a painted/moulded band, not a structural line
